The 2025 Openfront Masters Autumn Major was the second Major OpenFront tournament hosted by OpenFront Masters.

About

Format

  • Qualifiers - Sep 21th, 2025
    • 21 Registered teams
    • 1 Group
    • 7 games
    • Elimination by win
    • Map rotation: Pluto -> Baikal -> Gibraltar + Italia (once there are less than 16 teams remaining)
  • Final - Sep 21th, 2025
    • 7 Qualified teams
    • 1 Group
    • 1 Game
    • Map: Montreal (At the time of this event, the Montreal map was not yet in the main game)
